members.title: Judge orders Trump administration to restore White House access to CNN, MS Now and Politico
members.lead: US district judge Tim Kelly said the ban on the three media outlets was likely unconstitutional, in an order that must remain in effect for 14 days A federal judge has ordered the Trump administration to restore ⁠White House ⁠access ​to journalists from CNN, MS Now and Politico, ⁠saying his ban on the three media outlets was ⁠likely unconstitutional. US district judge Tim Kelly issued his order in a lawsuit that the news organizations filed ‌contesting the ban that the president announced ​on 18 September. Kelly said the order must remain in place for 14 days. Continue reading...

members.lead: Judge rules Trump’s ban of journalists from CNN, MS Now and Politico ⁠likely unconstitutional Sign up for US Breaking News emails Good morning and welcome to the US politics live blog. We start now with breaking news from the late night hours: a federal judge has temporarily restored White House access to journalists from CNN, Politico and MS Now after president Donald Trump banned them due to their coverage of his administration. US president Donald Trump and Chinese president Xi Jinping meet in Washington for high-stakes talks that expect to cover their competing economies, trade, artificial intelligence and Taiwan. Benjamin Netanyahu will speak at the UN general assembly today where he is expected to attack New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani, a vocal critic of the Israeli prime minister who has repeatedly described him as a war criminal.
